rules: One evaluation at a time, one attempt, at most three cases.
Verify release, fresh protocol and registry before each dispatch.
Each control references the completed primary on this same runtime; no input fallback.
Inspect the first boundary failure before another stage; no diagnostic qualifies a policy.
Capture final Job/Pod identities promptly; no default or local-model activation.
changes_from_previous_sequence: Same cases, policies, budgets and sequence; onboarding-v2 measurement revision is now v2.3. A new primary is required; old-suite source80 is never reused as its reference.
